description: This PHP source file defines the DateTimeHelperService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides utility methods for formatting dates and times, converting seconds to time strings, comparing dates, calculating date differences, generating date ranges, and retrieving week boundaries. It utilizes external classes like DateTime, DateInterval, and localized date formatting helpers.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperService
classes.description: A service class providing various date and time manipulation utilities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocalizedDateFormatter, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into 'Y-m-d' string format; returns null if input is null.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into an 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' string; returns null if input is null.

methods.name: convertSecondsToTimeString
methods.description: Converts seconds into a time string in 'H:i' or 'H:i:s' format.

methods.name: isDatesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two DateTime objects have the same date component, with an option to accept nulls as equal.

methods.name: dateDiffInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTimes.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Generates an array of DateTime objects within a specified range, given a start and end DateTime and optional duration.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime, optionally in a specified timezone.

methods.name: getNowInUTC
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime in UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeZone object based on a given offset in hours.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object according to system configuration or defaults.

methods.name: getWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week containing the given date, based on a specified week start day index.
